# Agent Plugins specification — FIRST CAPTURE 2026-08-24
# NOT IN sources.json. Read at:
#   https://agent-plugins.org
#   https://github.com/agentplugins/agent-plugins-spec
#   https://vercel.com/blog/introducing-agent-plugins
#   https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/opensource/aws-supports-agent-plugins-an-open-standard-for-portable-agent-extensions/
# CROSS-VENDOR. Not a platform — a format that changes SIX clients at once.

## AGENT PLUGINS 1.0.0 — released 2026-08-06     [reported 2026-08-24, HIGH/ENDPOINT]
Open, vendor-neutral, openly licensed. Technical Steering Committee:
  **AWS, Cursor, Microsoft, OpenAI, Vercel**  — "no single company's product roadmap sets the
  format's direction." Governance + contribution process public.
Spec, JSON Schemas, author/implementer guides: agent-plugins.org
Repo: agentplugins/agent-plugins-spec.  **1.1.0 is a WORKING DRAFT** — component set will grow.

Structure (a plugin is just a directory):
  plugin.json   REQUIRED manifest. MINIMUM = 2 fields:
                  { "$schema": "https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/1.0.0/plugin.schema.json",
                    "name": "my-plugin" }
                In practice also carries ACTIVATION KEYWORDS.
  skills/       OPTIONAL. Agent Skills format — folders each holding a SKILL.md with
                `name` + `description` frontmatter.
  mcp.json      OPTIONAL. Describes **stdio, Streamable HTTP, or legacy HTTP+SSE** MCP servers.

1.0.0 standardizes TWO component types: Agent Skills, and MCP servers.
Discovery: clients SCAN THE DIRECTORY STRUCTURE.
Installation, surfacing and distribution are DELIBERATELY LEFT TO EACH CLIENT
  ("preserving their ability to differentiate") => no standard trust prompt, no standard
  provenance record, no standard MCP-enablement gate.

## CLIENTS SUPPORTING IT TODAY (per Vercel, 2026-08-06)
  ChatGPT · Codex · Cursor · GitHub Copilot · Kiro · VS Code
=> ONE artifact, SIX clients, FIVE vendors. Per-vendor extension inventory cannot establish what
   an endpoint runs. Each vendor's management surface sees only its own slice.

## NO SECURITY SECTION ANYWHERE
Checked agent-plugins.org, the spec repo, the AWS announcement and the Vercel announcement.
None contains a security-considerations section. No signing, no provenance, no trust model.

## WHAT THIS MONITOR GOT WRONG (correction of record)
2026-08-07 reported "Codex Agent Plugins" as an OPENAI capability (repo marketplace at
  $REPO_ROOT/.agents/plugins/marketplace.json, personal at ~/.agents/plugins/marketplace.json).
2026-08-23 reported Foundry's Skills API + the agentskills.io spec as a Microsoft thing.
Kiro Powers, Agent Toolkit for AWS and Vercel's implementation are THE SAME FORMAT AGAIN.
=> Model "Agent Plugin" ONCE as a cross-vendor entity with one identity and MANY INSTALL SITES.

## AGENT TOOLKIT FOR AWS  [reported 2026-08-24, MEDIUM/AISPM]
docs.aws.amazon.com/agent-toolkit/latest/userguide/skills.html · github.com/aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws
Official AWS MCP servers + skills + plugins. **30+ curated skills**: service selection,
CDK/CloudFormation, serverless (Lambda), containers, storage (S3, DynamoDB), IAM policy config,
observability, billing, SDK usage, deployment; plus Bedrock/AgentCore agent-building skills and
S3 Tables / Glue / Athena data-lake+ETL skills. Skill types: service decision guides, step-by-step
procedures, troubleshooting guides, SDK usage guides.
Plugins ship for **Claude Code, Codex, Cursor**; Kiro consumes the same content as Powers.

FOUR INSTALL PATHS — the fourth leaves NOTHING ON DISK:
  1. bundled with a plugin (no network calls after install)
  2. downloaded individually from GitHub into the agent's skills directory
  3. `aws configure agent-toolkit` wizard / `aws agent-toolkit` commands — "DETECTS SUPPORTED
     AGENTS ON YOUR SYSTEM and installs skills into EACH agent's configuration directory"
     => one command fans one grant out to every agent client on the machine
  4. **RUNTIME via the AWS MCP Server, "without any local installation"** — agent calls
     `search_documentation` to find a skill, `retrieve_skill` to load it into context.
     => NO on-disk artifact. File-based endpoint collection CANNOT SEE IT.
        `retrieve_skill` is a named AIDR activity type.
Also: `npx skills add aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws/skills`
Lifecycle: loaded on demand, and "after the task is complete, your agent RELEASES the skill
content from context" => installed / loaded / active are THREE DIFFERENT SETS.
Skills "work best with the AWS MCP Server, which provides authenticated API access, sandboxed
script execution, and enterprise controls like CloudWatch metrics and IAM context keys," but also
work WITHOUT it by driving the AWS CLI directly.

Updated: 2026-08-24 — first capture. RECOMMEND adding agent-plugins.org + spec repo releases to
sources.json; 1.1.0 draft means the next component type changes six clients simultaneously.
